answer: Nikola Tesla did not win the Nobel Prize in Physics. While he was a renowned inventor and engineer whose work contributed significantly to electrical engineering and wireless transmission technology, he never received the Nobel Prize in Physics. There are historical accounts suggesting he may have been nominated or considered at various points, but no record of him actually winning the prize.
